data.summary:
Pension, Mutual Fund, and Private Equity Fund Accounting. Skilled in NAV calculation, reconciliation, and financial
reporting, with a strong track record of accuracy and compliance.
Expertise in daily and monthly cash, stock, and price reconciliations ensuring smooth fund operations.
Strong understanding of fund migration processes and preparation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for
newly migrated funds.
Adept at finalization of accounts, bank reconciliations, and maintaining books of accounts in line with accounting
Standards.
Hands-on experience with equities, bonds, swaps, options, mortgages, and futures, along with implementing effective
internal financial controls.
I am passionate about leveraging my technical knowledge and problem-solving skills to ensure accuracy, compliance,
and operational efficiency in fund management. Always eager to learn, grow, and contribute to dynamic finance teams.
Fund Accounting & Compliance:
Private Markets (PE, Credit, Hybrid) | Fund Lifecycle Management | NAV/GAV Calculation & Reconciliation | Audit & Regulatory Compliance | Capital Calls & Distributions (ROP/ROC) | Waterfall Modeling | Fee Structures | Drawdown & Evergreen Funds | LP/GP Reporting | Client Relationship Management
Leadership & Operations:
Cross-training & Mentoring | Process Automation | System Migration (MCH) | Process Optimization | Strategic Planning | Performance Turnarounds
Genpact Financial Services Limited

Professional Summary: -
Pension, Mutual Fund, and Private Equity Fund Accounting. Skilled in NAV calculation, reconciliation, and financial
reporting, with a strong track record of accuracy and compliance.
Expertise in daily and monthly cash, stock, and price reconciliations ensuring smooth fund operations.
Strong understanding of fund migration processes and preparation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for
newly migrated funds.
Adept at finalization of accounts, bank reconciliations, and maintaining books of accounts in line with accounting
Standards.
Hands-on experience with equities, bonds, swaps, options, mortgages, and futures, along with implementing effective
internal financial controls.
I am passionate about leveraging my technical knowledge and problem-solving skills to ensure accuracy, compliance,
and operational efficiency in fund management. Always eager to learn, grow, and contribute to dynamic finance teams.
Fund Accounting & Compliance:

Private Markets (PE, Credit, Hybrid) | Fund Lifecycle Management | NAV/GAV Calculation & Reconciliation | Audit & Regulatory Compliance | Capital Calls & Distributions (ROP/ROC) | Waterfall Modeling | Fee Structures | Drawdown & Evergreen Funds | LP/GP Reporting | Client Relationship Management
Leadership & Operations:
Cross-training & Mentoring | Process Automation | System Migration (MCH) | Process Optimization | Strategic Planning | Performance Turnarounds
Genpact Financial Services Limited
raw_sections.experience:
Senior Associate, Fund Accounting – Private Markets | Dec 2024 – Present
Review and sign off NAV and Financials of the Private equity and Hybrid Funds that include recording Journal Entries, preparing monthly/Quarterly/Annual Financials, processing payments, preparing investor notices and various client reporting.
Review Capital Call and distribution workings along with notices and release to respective investors.
Manage end execute conversion of Private Equity Funds from other accounting applications to InvestOne.
Develop various KPIs to be followed and ensure all necessary controls are put in place in the process.
Manage work allocation among the team and ensure back up plans are in place.

Identify and implement process improvement techniques to improve the process efficiency and team productivity.
Managing the client relationships for the Funds and individually handle the deliverable requirements on daily/weekly/monthly/Quarterly basis.

Liaising with Onshore team, clients and Auditors on various requirements and ensure all supports are provided to the auditors to get the financials approved on the agreed timeline.

Liaising with multiple stake holders in the organization and ensure the tight deadlines are met.
Onboard new PE/Hybrid Funds in the accounting platforms (InvestOne/Unity).
Review general ledger exceptions. Identify cause and make necessary adjustment.
Accenture Services
Associate, Trade Settlement –Mutual/Hybrid Funds | Nov2023 – Dec 2024
Managed the entire FX OTC cash settlement process, handling tasks from trade confirmation to reconciliation, ensuring smooth operations, timely processing, and resolving any issues that arose.
Handled break reconciliation in the settlement process, identifying and fixing discrepancies or issues. This included investigating unmatched or failed trades and resolving problems with counterparties or internal systems.
Managed Standing Settlement Instructions (SSI), overseeing the necessary details and instructions for trade
settlement.

Proficient in Bloomberg, FXall, CLS, MT300, Alert, and GTSS, demonstrating expertise in using industry standard tools for efficient trade matching, confirmation, and settlement in the FX market. These platforms streamline communication and trade processing among diverse counterparties. Coordinated client meeting, trained teams, and maintained process documentation (MoMs, updates).
State Street Syntel Services (formerly State Street.)
Officer, Fund Accounting – Pension Funds | Jan 2021 – April2023
Managing day to day accounting activities for Dutch & Swiss Clients including preparing and reviewing Daily, Validation of NAV.
Monthly Accounting.

Skilled at preparing reconciliation for all the funds including Cash Recon, Stock Recon & Price Recon on Daily & Monthly basis.
Net Asset Value calculation, Fund pricing, reconciliation of trade balances, uploading daily trade transaction
details and review.

Expertise in calculation of Net Asset Value and preparation of statements.
Confirming all price movements which breach previously set tolerances to an external source such as
Reuters/Bloomberg/IDC/FTS.
Reviewed broker statements for accuracy, ensuring proper trade execution and reconciliation.
Assisted in trade processing for equities, bonds, swaps, and forward contracts.
BAF., SIES College of Commerce & Economics, Mumbai University – 2019
**********
